translation: Ten: The 《Zhuangzi》 says: “The scholar of guiding and leading, the person who nourishes the form,” and the 《Biography of the Marquis of Liu》 says: “Guiding and leading, not eating grain,” with a note saying: “The method of taking qi.” I do not know whether this method has a transmitted book in the world. But carefully analyzing the meaning of the two words “guiding and leading” (道引), dao is to make it move, and yin is to make it go; it seems close to the rubbing method.
